description:
As a customer, I want to filter the products.

* Filters should narrow down the list correctly.

criteria.text: As a customer, I am able to filter the products (filtering is available on the product list).
Filters should narrow down the list correctly (the resulting list contains only products matching the applied filter).

cases.title: Customer can apply a filter on the product list
cases.preconditions: The application is reachable; the product list page is available and contains several products. The tester is acting as a customer (no special permissions assumed).
steps: Open the product list page as a customer.
Locate the filter control(s) offered on the page (the story does not specify which filter attributes or control types exist - not specified in the story).
Apply the filter (via the apply/confirm action offered by the UI - not specified in the story).
cases.expected: Filtering is available to the customer and the selected filter is accepted and applied; the product list is refreshed with the filter in effect. The exact filter attributes, control layout and confirmation wording are not specified in the story.

cases.title: Applied filter narrows the list to matching products only
cases.preconditions: The product list page contains a known mix of products: at least 3 products that match a chosen filter value and at least 3 products that do not match it. The tester knows which products belong to each group.
steps: Open the product list page as a customer.
Record the products shown before filtering.
Select the chosen filter value and apply the filter.
Compare the resulting list against the recorded data.
cases.expected: The resulting list shows only the products that match the applied filter value; none of the non-matching products are shown, and no matching product is missing. Sorting, paging and count display behaviour are not specified in the story.

cases.title: Filter value that matches no product
cases.preconditions: The product list page is available, and a filter value exists for which no product in the catalogue matches.
steps: Open the product list page as a customer.
Select the filter value that no product matches.
cases.expected: No products are shown, because no product matches the filter - the filter must not display non-matching products. The exact empty-result message or screen is not specified in the story.

cases.title: Filter value that matches every product
cases.preconditions: The product list page is available and all products in the catalogue share the same value for one filterable attribute.
steps: Open the product list page as a customer.
Record the full product list before filtering.
Select the filter value shared by all products and apply the filter.
cases.expected: The resulting list still contains all products, since all of them match the filter; no product is incorrectly removed.

cases.title: Filtering is performed on the product list without a filter applied
cases.preconditions: The product list page is available and contains several products; no filter has been applied yet in this session.
steps: Open the product list page as a customer.
Do not select any filter value.
cases.expected: With no filter applied, the list is not narrowed - all products of the unfiltered list are shown. The story specifies narrowing only as a result of applying filters; default filter pre-selection is not specified in the story.
